title: Machine installation
text: Retire the machine with `yoke --env ENV machine retire MACHINE_ID --confirm` before removing its connection or uninstalling Yoke. Both cleanup commands report the saved machine ID and leave the server record in place. Its owner or a server administrator can retire it from another machine connected to the same server. Machine uninstall on macOS, systemd Linux and Windows removes saved relay services (launchd jobs, systemd units, scheduled tasks) even after their connection aliases were removed. It first closes the identity browsers and Browser QA daemons Yoke started, and stops before any other change when one stays open. If the detached CLI removal fails, its log names a shell command that removes the releases folder without yoke. Unproven ownership or a failed stop retains the machine home and CLI for recovery.
